title: Usage
description:
Token usage accounting from the provider.

`cached_tokens` and `reasoning_tokens` are the detail providers report beyond the three headline counts (Anthropic's cache reads, OpenAI's `prompt_tokens_details` / `completion_tokens_details`, Gemini's thoughts): optional and absent on the wire when unset, so the pinned serde shape of the headline fields is unchanged.

cached_tokens.description: Prompt tokens served from the provider's cache. A *subset* of `prompt_tokens`, usually billed at a lower rate.

reasoning_tokens.description: Completion tokens spent on reasoning rather than visible output. A *subset* of `completion_tokens`.
